summary: Join our AI-Powered Fraud Detection & Analytics Training Course to gain expertise in advanced fraud prevention strategies and analytics tools. Enroll today!
lede: AI-powered fraud detection and risk analysis uses transaction data, anomaly detection and risk scoring to help teams identify and investigate suspicious activity. For fraud officers, auditors, compliance professionals and risk teams, the course focuses on turning analytics into defensible controls and investigation evidence. Learners practise interpreting monitoring dashboards and AI outputs, prioritizing alerts, distinguishing meaningful red flags from noise, and explaining findings with documentation and attention to bias.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who play a role in fraud prevention, detection, investigation, or oversight, including:
audience: NGO grant, program, and finance managers
modules: Understanding Modern Fraud and AI’s Role
Fraud Risk Areas and Data Sources
AI Techniques Used in Fraud Detection
Bias, Ethics, and Governance in AI Use
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of risk management and basic data analysis.
